title: pi sandbox.json
description: Generated from SandboxRuntimeConfigSchema in @carderne/sandbox-runtime 0.0.49. Regenerate after upgrading pi.

allowUnixSockets.description: macOS only: Unix socket paths to allow. Ignored on Linux (seccomp cannot filter by path).

allowAllUnixSockets.description: If true, allow all Unix sockets (disables blocking on both platforms).

allowLocalBinding.description: Whether to allow binding to local ports (default: false)

allowMachLookup.description: macOS only: Additional XPC/Mach service names to allow looking up. Supports trailing-wildcard prefix matching (e.g., "2BUA8C4S2C.com.1password.*"). Needed for tools like 1Password CLI, Playwright, or the iOS Simulator that communicate via XPC.

httpProxyPort.description: Port of an external HTTP proxy to use instead of starting a local one. When provided, the library will skip starting its own HTTP proxy and use this port. The external proxy must handle domain filtering.

socksProxyPort.description: Port of an external SOCKS proxy to use instead of starting a local one. When provided, the library will skip starting its own SOCKS proxy and use this port. The external proxy must handle domain filtering.

socketPath.description: Unix socket path to the MITM proxy

domains.description: Domains to route through the MITM proxy (e.g., ["api.example.com", "*.internal.org"])

mitmProxy.description: Optional MITM proxy configuration. Routes matching domains through an upstream proxy via Unix socket while SRT still handles allow/deny filtering.

http.description: Upstream proxy URL for plain HTTP traffic

https.description: Upstream proxy URL for HTTPS/CONNECT traffic (falls back to http if unset)

noProxy.description: Comma-separated NO_PROXY list (hostname suffixes and CIDR ranges). Matching destinations connect directly instead of via the parent proxy.

parentProxy.description: Upstream HTTP proxy for outbound connections. When set, SRT's proxy tunnels non-mitmProxy traffic through this parent instead of connecting directly. Falls back to HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/NO_PROXY env vars if unset.

allowRead.description: Paths to re-allow reading within denied regions (takes precedence over denyRead). Use with denyRead to deny a broad region then allow back specific subdirectories.

denyWrite.description: Paths denied for writing (takes precedence over allowWrite)

allowGitConfig.description: Allow writes to .git/config files (default: false). Enables git remote URL updates while keeping .git/hooks protected.

ignoreViolations.description: Optional configuration for ignoring specific violations

enableWeakerNestedSandbox.description: Enable weaker nested sandbox mode (for Docker environments)

enableWeakerNetworkIsolation.description: Enable weaker network isolation to allow access to com.apple.trustd.agent (macOS only). This is needed for Go programs (gh, gcloud, terraform, kubectl, etc.) to verify TLS certificates when using httpProxyPort with a MITM proxy and custom CA. Enabling this opens a potential data exfiltration vector through the trustd service. Only enable if you need Go TLS verification.

args.description: Additional arguments to pass before ripgrep args

argv0.description: Override argv[0] when spawning (for multicall binaries that dispatch on argv[0])

mandatoryDenySearchDepth.description: Maximum directory depth to search for dangerous files on Linux (default: 3). Higher values provide more protection but slower performance.

allowBrowserProcess.description: Allow browser process operations (macOS only). Grants the additional Mach IPC, Mach bootstrap registration, and IOKit permissions that Chromium-based browsers need to launch and run inside the sandbox. Required for tools like agent-browser that spawn a Chrome/Chromium subprocess. Without this, Chrome will crash on startup due to denied Mach service lookups and bootstrap registrations.

argv0.description: Invoke apply-seccomp as a multicall binary that dispatches on the ARGV0 environment variable. When set, applyPath is used verbatim (no existence check) and the invocation inside bwrap is prefixed with ARGV0=<this value>. The caller is responsible for ensuring applyPath resolves inside the bwrap namespace and that the target binary implements the apply-seccomp interface when ARGV0 matches.

$schema.description: Path to this schema; ignored by the sandbox runtime.
